summary.en: AlmapBBDO built SYNTHS to simulate consumer opinions via Google AI for real-time campaign insights.
summary.zh: AlmapBBDO 開發 SYNTHS 平台，運用 Google AI 即時模擬消費者輪廓意見，加速廣告創意策略優化。

overview.en: AlmapBBDO, a leading Brazilian advertising agency, developed SYNTHS — a platform built on Gemini models that transforms synthetic data into campaign insights. The solution simulates opinions from various consumer profiles in real time, enabling agile refinement of creative ideas. In comparative tests, SYNTHS' AI-generated recommendations aligned with those from real consumer research.
overview.zh: AlmapBBDO 是巴西知名廣告代理商，開發出名為 SYNTHS 的平台，以 Gemini 模型為基礎，將合成資料轉化為廣告活動洞察。該系統能即時模擬多種消費者輪廓的意見，讓創意策略能快速疊代。在比較測試中，AI 生成的建議與真實消費者研究結果一致。

en: SYNTHS uses Gemini models to simulate consumer opinions from diverse profiles in real time.
AI-generated recommendations matched those from research conducted with real consumers in comparative tests.
Enables agile refinement of creative strategies without waiting for traditional consumer research timelines.
zh: SYNTHS 使用 Gemini 模型即時模擬多元消費者輪廓的意見。
在比較測試中，AI 生成的建議與真實消費者研究結論一致。
無需等待傳統消費者研究週期，即可快速疊代廣告創意策略。

summary.en: Backstory's Revenue Answers Agent synthesizes CRM and stakeholder data to surface deal risks and actions.
summary.zh: Backstory 的 Revenue Answers Agent 整合 CRM 與利害關係人資料，即時揭露交易風險並提供行動建議。

overview.en: Backstory built a Revenue Answers Agent that tells revenue leaders what is happening on any account, identifies deal risks, and suggests next actions. The agent synthesizes CRM data, engagement activity, stakeholder relationships, and public company news into actionable intelligence, enabling sales teams to respond proactively rather than reactively.
overview.zh: Backstory 開發了 Revenue Answers Agent，能即時告知營收主管各客戶帳號的動態、辨識交易風險並建議下一步行動。該 Agent 整合 CRM 資料、互動記錄、利害關係人關係與公開公司新聞，轉化為可行動的業務洞察，協助銷售團隊主動應對。

en: Synthesizes CRM data, stakeholder relationships, and public news into a single revenue intelligence view.
Proactively identifies deal risks before they escalate.
Suggests concrete next actions for revenue leaders to act on.
zh: 整合 CRM 資料、利害關係人關係與公開新聞，提供統一的營收情報視圖。
主動在問題升溫前識別交易風險。
為營收主管提供具體的下一步行動建議。

summary.en: Contraktor uses AI to analyze and review contracts, cutting review time by up to 75%.
summary.zh: Contraktor 採用 AI 分析與審查合約，將審查時間縮短最多 75%。

overview.en: Contraktor, a contract management platform, developed an AI-powered project to analyze contracts using Google Cloud. The solution reads and extracts relevant data from documents automatically. As a result, contract analysis and review time was reduced by up to 75%, enabling legal and procurement teams to work far more efficiently.
overview.zh: Contraktor 是一個合約管理平台，利用 Google Cloud 開發了 AI 驅動的合約分析專案。解決方案能自動讀取並擷取文件中的關鍵資料，使合約分析與審查時間縮短最多 75%，讓法務與採購團隊的工作效率大幅提升。

en: AI-powered contract analysis reduces review time by up to 75%.
Automatically reads and extracts relevant data from contract documents.
Enables faster legal and procurement workflows across the organization.
zh: AI 驅動的合約分析將審查時間縮短最多 75%。
自動讀取並擷取合約文件中的相關資料。
加快組織內法務與採購流程。

sources.title: Google Cloud — 1,302 real-world gen AI use cases

summary.en: Croud uses custom Gemini Gems for data analysis and marketing tasks, achieving 4–5× productivity gains.
summary.zh: Croud 使用自訂 Gemini Gems 執行資料分析與行銷任務，部分作業生產力提升達 4 至 5 倍。

overview.en: Croud is a global media agency with over 650 employees specializing in performance and brand marketing. The company uses custom Gemini Gems for email sentiment analysis, complex data analysis, coding assistance, and supplier-specific data workflows. This approach enables employees to execute repeatable tasks independently, achieving 4–5× productivity improvements for certain tasks.
overview.zh: Croud 是一家擁有逾 650 名員工的全球媒體代理商，專注於效果行銷與品牌行銷。公司使用自訂 Gemini Gems 執行電子郵件情感分析、複雜資料分析、程式協助及供應商專屬資料流程，讓員工能獨立完成可重複性任務，部分作業生產力提升達 4 至 5 倍。

en: Custom Gemini Gems enable 4–5× productivity improvements for certain repeatable tasks.
Used for email sentiment analysis, complex data analysis, and coding assistance.
Employees can independently execute supplier-specific data workflows without specialized help.
zh: 自訂 Gemini Gems 讓部分可重複性任務的生產力提升達 4 至 5 倍。
應用於電子郵件情感分析、複雜資料分析及程式協助。
員工可獨立執行供應商專屬資料流程，無需額外協助。

summary.en: Fifth Dimension's AI agent Ellie compresses days of real estate deal workflows into 5–10 minutes on Google Cloud.
summary.zh: Fifth Dimension 的 AI Agent Ellie 將房地產交易篩選與承銷流程從數天壓縮至 5 至 10 分鐘。

overview.en: Fifth Dimension is an AI-native operating system for real estate, built on Google Cloud using Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Its AI agent, Ellie, executes complex workflows like deal screening and underwriting with full portfolio context. Tasks that previously required days of manual assembly are now completed in five to ten minutes.
overview.zh: Fifth Dimension 是以 Google Cloud 為基礎的房地產 AI 原生作業系統，採用 Pub/Sub、Cloud Run、Cloud Storage、Cloud SQL 及 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 構建。其 AI Agent Ellie 能在具備完整投資組合脈絡的情況下執行交易篩選與承銷等複雜流程，原本需要數天手動整合的工作現在只需 5 至 10 分鐘即可完成。

en: AI agent Ellie performs deal screening and underwriting with full portfolio context.
Reduces complex multi-day workflows to just 5–10 minutes.
Built on Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
zh: AI Agent Ellie 在具備完整投資組合脈絡的情況下執行交易篩選與承銷作業。
將原需數天的複雜流程縮短至僅需 5 至 10 分鐘。
基於 Pub/Sub、Cloud Run、Cloud Storage、Cloud SQL 及 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 構建。

sources.title: Google Cloud — 1,302 real-world gen AI use cases

summary.en: Galaxies uses BigQuery and Vertex AI to create synthetic consumer personas, cutting research costs by 85%.
summary.zh: Galaxies 利用 BigQuery 與 Vertex AI 創建合成消費者人設，將研究直接成本降低 85%。

overview.en: Galaxies uses BigQuery, Vertex AI, and Cloud Storage to create 'Synthetic Personas' powered by advanced clustering and LLMs trained exclusively on proprietary data. This enables marketing campaigns to be tested with hundreds of profiles in 48 hours instead of months. The Google Cloud migration also achieved 85% savings in direct research costs while providing an integrated environment for data lake, data warehouse, machine learning, and generative AI operations.
overview.zh: Galaxies 使用 BigQuery、Vertex AI 及 Cloud Storage，以先進叢集分析和僅在專有資料上訓練的 LLM，打造「合成人設」。行銷活動現在可在 48 小時內以數百個人設進行測試，而非以往的數月。遷移至 Google Cloud 後，直接研究成本節省 85%，同時提供數據湖、數據倉庫、機器學習與生成式 AI 的整合環境。

en: Synthetic Personas enable marketing campaign testing with hundreds of profiles in 48 hours instead of months.
Google Cloud migration achieved 85% savings in direct research costs.
Integrated environment covers data lake, data warehouse, ML, and generative AI operations.
zh: 合成人設讓行銷活動可在 48 小時內以數百個人設進行測試，而非數月。
遷移至 Google Cloud 後，直接研究成本節省 85%。
提供涵蓋數據湖、數據倉庫、機器學習及生成式 AI 的整合環境。

summary.zh: Gamuda Berhad 打造 Bot Unify 平台，讓建設專案團隊普及使用 Gemini 模型獲取即時資訊與洞察。

overview.en: Gamuda Berhad, a Malaysian infrastructure and property management company, developed Bot Unify — a platform that democratizes generative AI for construction projects. The platform gives users access to Gemini models and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) frameworks, enabling faster information retrieval and insights during active construction projects.
overview.zh: 馬來西亞基礎建設與房地產管理公司 Gamuda Berhad 開發了 Bot Unify 平台，讓建設專案的使用者普及使用 Gemini 模型和 RAG（檢索增強生成）框架，在工程進行中快速取得資訊與洞察。

en: Bot Unify democratizes generative AI access for construction project teams.
Integrates Gemini models and RAG frameworks for faster information retrieval.
Provides real-time insights during active infrastructure projects.
zh: Bot Unify 讓建設專案團隊普及使用生成式 AI。
整合 Gemini 模型與 RAG 框架，加速資訊檢索。
在基礎建設工程進行中提供即時洞察。

summary.en: Gazelle uses Gemini to generate real estate sales content in 10 seconds with 99.9% accuracy, down from 4 hours.
summary.zh: Gazelle 使用 Gemini 在 10 秒內以 99.9% 準確率生成房產銷售內容，原需 4 小時。

overview.en: Gazelle is an AI service automating property documentation for real estate agents in Sweden and Norway. Built on Google Cloud, it uses Gemini models to extract key information from lengthy property documents and generate sales content. The platform increased output accuracy from 95% to 99.9%, reduced content generation time from four hours to just 10 seconds, and enabled the launch of four new products in under a year.
overview.zh: Gazelle 是一項為瑞典和挪威房仲自動化處理房產文件的 AI 服務。基於 Google Cloud 構建，使用 Gemini 模型從冗長的房產文件中擷取關鍵資訊並生成銷售內容。平台將輸出準確率從 95% 提升至 99.9%，內容生成時間從 4 小時縮短至僅 10 秒，並在不到一年內推出 4 項新產品。

en: Content generation time reduced from 4 hours to 10 seconds using Gemini.
Output accuracy improved from 95% to 99.9%.
Launched 4 new products in under a year enabled by the AI platform.
zh: 內容生成時間透過 Gemini 從 4 小時縮短至 10 秒。
輸出準確率從 95% 提升至 99.9%。
AI 平台支持在不到一年內推出 4 項新產品。

summary.zh: Habi 導入 AI 解決方案，簡化並自動化哥倫比亞房地產交易中的實體與數位文件管理與驗證。

overview.en: Habi, a Colombian real estate company, implemented AI solutions on Google Cloud to streamline and automate the management and verification of physical and digital documents. The initiative improved validation operations and increased the efficiency and adaptability of employees handling document-intensive real estate processes.
overview.zh: 哥倫比亞房地產公司 Habi 在 Google Cloud 上導入 AI 解決方案，簡化並自動化實體與數位文件的管理與驗證流程。此舉改善了驗證作業，並提升了處理大量文件的員工效率與適應能力。

en: AI automates management and verification of physical and digital real estate documents.
Improved validation operations across document-intensive workflows.
Increased employee efficiency and adaptability in real estate processes.
zh: AI 自動化管理與驗證房地產交易的實體與數位文件。
改善高文件量工作流程中的驗證作業。
提升房地產流程中員工的效率與適應能力。

summary.zh: HCLTech 推出 HCLTech Insight，一個利用 Vertex AI 預測並消除製造缺陷的 AI Agent。

overview.en: HCLTech, a global technology company, launched HCLTech Insight — a manufacturing quality AI agent that helps predict and eliminate different types of defects in manufacturing processes. The solution is built on Vertex AI, Google Cloud's Cortex Framework, and the Manufacturing Data Engine platform, enabling data-driven quality management at scale.
overview.zh: 全球科技公司 HCLTech 推出 HCLTech Insight，這是一個製造品質 AI Agent，能協助預測並消除製造流程中各類缺陷。該解決方案基於 Vertex AI、Google Cloud Cortex Framework 及 Manufacturing Data Engine 平台構建，實現規模化資料驅動的品質管理。

en: HCLTech Insight AI agent predicts and eliminates manufacturing defects.
Built on Vertex AI, Google Cloud Cortex Framework, and Manufacturing Data Engine.
Enables data-driven quality management at scale across manufacturing operations.
zh: HCLTech Insight AI Agent 預測並消除製造缺陷。
基於 Vertex AI、Google Cloud Cortex Framework 及 Manufacturing Data Engine 構建。
在製造作業中實現規模化資料驅動的品質管理。

summary.en: IPRally built an NLP-based ML platform to search over 120 million patent documents with 200,000 new sources added weekly.
summary.zh: IPRally 打造 NLP 機器學習平台，可搜尋逾 1.2 億份全球專利文件，每週新增超過 20 萬筆來源。

overview.en: IPRally built a custom machine-learning platform on Google Cloud that uses natural language processing on the text of more than 120 million global patent documents, creating an accurate and easily searchable database. More than 200,000 new patent sources are added each week. The platform uses graph neural networks and GKE-based infrastructure to deliver fast, accurate patent search at enterprise scale.
overview.zh: IPRally 在 Google Cloud 上構建了自訂機器學習平台，以 NLP 技術處理逾 1.2 億份全球專利文件，打造精準且易於搜尋的資料庫，每週新增超過 20 萬筆專利來源。平台採用圖神經網路和基於 GKE 的基礎架構，以企業規模提供快速準確的專利搜尋。

en: NLP platform covers over 120 million global patent documents.
Adds more than 200,000 new patent sources every week.
Built on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) with graph neural network technology for accurate semantic search.
zh: NLP 平台涵蓋逾 1.2 億份全球專利文件。
每週新增超過 20 萬筆專利來源。
基於 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 及圖神經網路技術，提供精準的語義搜尋。

en: Powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro and Flash models for data analysis.
Grounding with Google Search enhances real-world accuracy using contemporaneous information.
Eliminates time-consuming data analyst requests, empowering researchers to self-serve.
zh: 由 Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 Flash 模型驅動進行資料分析。
以 Google 搜尋為基礎的接地功能利用即時資訊提升準確性。
消除耗時的資料分析師請求，讓研究人員可自助操作。

summary.zh: Juganu 與 Google Cloud 合作開發 AI 數位孿生，自動化零售門市的日常作業。

overview.zh: 智慧城市與智慧門市 SaaS 供應商 Juganu 與 Google Cloud 合作，自動化並數位化實體零售門市。公司正在開發數位孿生，為零售商提供門市的虛擬視角，自動化日常任務、提升效率並帶來更佳的顧客體驗。

en: Developing AI-powered digital twins to provide retailers with virtual store visibility.
Automates routine tasks in physical retail environments.
Aims to improve operational efficiency and enhance customer experience.
zh: 開發 AI 驅動的數位孿生，為零售商提供門市虛擬視角。
自動化實體零售環境中的日常任務。
旨在提升營運效率並改善顧客體驗。

summary.zh: Kyndryl 擴大與 Google Cloud 的合作，提供 Distributed Cloud 服務，支援主權與 AI 就緒的應用程式。

Enables enterprises to maintain data residency and sovereignty compliance.
Covers hybrid, multicloud, and edge environments with unified governance and security.

協助企業維護資料存放地點與主權合規要求。

Optimizing entire supply chain through AI-driven insights.
Using AI to create competitive differentiation in freight and logistics.

summary.zh: Onix 的 Risk & Compliance Intelligence Agent 將合規審查時間從數週縮短至數分鐘，並附帶詳細稽核軌跡。

overview.en: Onix's Risk & Compliance Intelligence Agent automates compliance reviews and risk assessments across regulated industries. overview.zh: Onix 的 Risk & Compliance Intelligence Agent 在受監管行業中自動化合規審查與風險評估。該 Agent 將審查時間從數週縮短至數分鐘，主動識別監管風險，並建立附有引用的詳細稽核軌跡，協助組織更有效率且透明地維護合規。

en: Reduces compliance review times from weeks to minutes.

overview.zh: 全球專業服務公司 Genpact 使用 Wiz（現為 Google Cloud 一部分的雲端安全平台），將零日漏洞的修復速度改善至 7 天內完成。此實施使 Genpact 獲得對其多雲環境的集中可見性，涵蓋逾 6,600 個工作負載，包括 Kubernetes、容器化應用程式和 LLM 模型。

en: Zero-day vulnerability remediation improved to within 7 days using Wiz.
Centralized visibility across 6,600+ multi-cloud workloads.
Covers Kubernetes, containerized apps, and LLM models in the security posture.
zh: 使用 Wiz 將零日漏洞修復速度改善至 7 天內完成。
對逾 6,600 個多雲工作負載實現集中可見性。
安全態勢涵蓋 Kubernetes、容器化應用程式和 LLM 模型。

summary.en: Sutherland contains potential intrusions in under 24 hours and shifted from reactive defense to proactive threat hunting.
summary.zh: Sutherland 在 24 小時內遏制潛在入侵，並從被動防禦轉型為主動威脅追蹤。

overview.en: Sutherland, a global process transformation company, now contains potential intrusions in under 24 hours and has transitioned from reactive defense to proactive threat hunting using Google Cloud security capabilities. The transformation reflects a more mature security operations posture, with AI-powered tools enabling the team to anticipate and neutralize threats before they escalate.
overview.zh: 全球流程轉型公司 Sutherland 現在能在 24 小時內遏制潛在入侵，並借助 Google Cloud 安全功能從被動防禦轉型為主動威脅追蹤。此轉型反映了更成熟的安全運營態勢，AI 驅動工具讓團隊能在威脅升溫前預測並中和威脅。

en: Potential intrusions contained in under 24 hours.
Transitioned from reactive defense to proactive threat hunting.
AI-powered security enables anticipating and neutralizing threats before escalation.
